summary: Sporting News previews the 2024 NBA MVP betting market, profiling early favorites Nikola Jokic, Luka Doncic, Giannis Antetokounmpo and reigning MVP Joel Embiid. It explains how to sign up and bet at sportsbooks, when to bet on futures, how MVP voting works, and lists MVP winners since 2010 plus a short FAQ.
one_line: Overview of 2024 NBA MVP betting favorites, how to bet on futures, how MVP voting works, and recent winners.
key_facts: Nikola Jokic fell short of a third consecutive MVP last season but led Denver to its first NBA championship.
Luka Doncic has been among the preseason favorites for three years, but his prospects declined because of limited support in Dallas and the Mavericks' recent playoff absence.
Giannis Antetokounmpo is a two-time MVP, is 28, and missed much of Milwaukee's surprising first-round loss to the Heat last season.
Joel Embiid is the reigning MVP (2022-23), led the league in scoring and showed superior rim defense, but the Sixers had playoff setbacks.
Early NBA MVP lines offer the best odds because oddsmakers have little information; lines become less favorable as the season produces data.
The NBA MVP is chosen by a panel of sportswriters and broadcasters, a format that started in 1980.
Each voter picks a top three: first place is worth five points, second three points, and third one point.
Steph Curry of the Golden State Warriors in 2015-16 was the last player to receive all first-place votes.
Recommended sportsbooks for MVP futures are DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM and Caesars.

MVP winners since 2010-11 include Derrick Rose, LeBron James (2011-12, 2012-13), Kevin Durant, Curry (2014-15, 2015-16), Russell Westbrook, James Harden, Giannis (2018-19, 2019-20), Jokic (2020-21, 2021-22) and Embiid.
Kareem Abdul-Jabbar has the most MVP awards with six: three with the Milwaukee Bucks and three with the Los Angeles Lakers.
Bill Russell (Boston Celtics) and Michael Jordan (Chicago Bulls) each have five MVP awards.
The NBA is the second-most popular sport in the US for betting, behind only the NFL.
